root_idea.summary: The root centers on shrinking back, retreating, or turning away from something.
root_idea.development: Its core development is withdrawal from an undertaking, especially through apprehension or cowardice; it can also describe turning back from a course previously pursued, including a good course.

senses.definition: To shrink back from, recoil from, or turn away from a matter; to retreat or desist from it, including turning back from a course already undertaken.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ for withdrawing or refraining from a matter. The construction عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ expresses turning back from something previously undertaken. Fear or awe may motivate the withdrawal, but is not an obligatory semantic condition; the matter abandoned may be good or evil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Receding or diminishing, especially of a person's lot or good fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in an idiomatic description of one's share or fortune as withdrawing or declining.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of retreat or withdrawal; a remote place to which one removes or retires.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place, comparable to مُتَنَحًّى.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The meanings of retreating, refraining, recoiling, and turning back from an undertaking are covered by the Quranic sense.
The idiomatic use for receding fortune is represented separately.
The noun of place meaning a place of retreat is represented separately.

cautions: Lane's supplied printed Quran reference to “xxiii. 68” is preserved only as evidence for a Quranic construction and is not normalized into a modern verse location; the examples use only the independently supplied QAC locations.
